name: pg_collate_icu_utf8_disallow_partitionwise_grouping
subject: Disallow partitionwise grouping when collations don't match
goal:
Full partitionwise aggregation can produce wrong groups when a GROUP BY expression uses a collation different from the corresponding partition key. Values that the partition-key collation separates may compare equal under the grouping collation, so finalizing each partition independently is not equivalent to grouping the table as a whole.

On a text table partitioned with `COLLATE "C"`, group by the key under a case-insensitive ICU collation and compare the rows with partitionwise aggregation disabled and enabled. The results must agree, and the unsafe full-partitionwise plan must not be selected. Grouping under the partition key's own collation, and safe partial partitionwise aggregation followed by a global finalization, must remain eligible.
